exposure: Newborn screening for CUD (low free carnitine (C0) values)
cohort: The study included forty-six infants born between 2017 and 2020 who were recalled for low free carnitine (C0) values from a total of 160,015 newborns screened.
finding: Newborn screening for Carnitine Uptake Deficiency (CUD) is burdened by a high false positive rate, identifying not only individuals with CUD but also those with maternal disorders and asymptomatic heterozygous individuals.
mod_finding: C-section was identified as one of the additional factors potentially contributing to observed low C0 values among false positives.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was identified as a factor potentially contributing to observed low C0 values among false positives.
gest_age: Gestational age < 37 weeks was identified as a factor potentially contributing to observed low C0 values among false positives.
